title: Cylindrical object
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In this sketch, draw a single circle with its center located at coordinates (0.03, 0.03) and a radius of 0.03 units. After completing the sketch, scale it uniformly by a factor of 0.06 to ensure the dimensions are accurate. The scaled sketch should then be transformed into three-dimensional space by applying the same rotation and translation values used in the initial coordinate system setup. Finally, extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to create a solid body. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object will be 0.06 units in length, 0.06 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.03, 0.03)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.03)        # Draw a circle with radius 0.03
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = (
    sketch
    .extrude(0.75)       # Extrude the circle to create a cylinder of height 0.75
)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
